posts.text: Happy Veterans Day to all my fellow veterans across Montana. Montana serves at one of the highest percentages in the country. We are proud to call so many veterans our friends and neighbors. To all who have worn our nation’s uniform, thank you for serving our country. https://t.co/SXFEzSPRri

Happy 251st birthday to the United States Marine Corps. To every Marine in Montana and across the country who has earned the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor, thank you for answering the call and defending our freedom. Semper Fi! https://t.co/nebFsJ3tS9

Lola and I are heartbroken by the loss of Lincoln County Deputy Ryan Terpsma, who was killed while protecting his community and doing his duty. We are praying for his family and fellow officers, and for the families of those who were killed or injured during this incident. May God bring comfort and strength to everyone affected by this tragedy.

Happy opening day Montana! Good luck to everyone heading out for rifle season. Hunting is part of who we are, and protecting our public lands allows us to pass that tradition on to our kids. Hunt safe and fill those freezers.
Always great to start the morning at Montana Coffee. Good coffee, great conversations, and this morning, an extra blessing with a prayer to start the day. https://t.co/uJDvCIcOsp

Twenty-five years ago America was attacked on our home soil. Today, we remember the 2,977 innocent lives lost and the courage our nation showed in the face of evil.

God bless America. Never forget. https://t.co/X587DGLv7x
https://t.co/kJ3fmcgoP2

The A River Runs Through It Act is a made in Montana solution, and I’m proud to introduce it. It supports our timber industry, reduces wildfire risk, protects public access, and keeps the Blackfoot working for everybody. Thanks to everyone who joined us at the introduction event at the legendary Smoke Elzer’s Barn in Missoula.

Attention Gallatin County and the surrounding area: my office is teaming up with Senator Sheehy’s and the Seattle Passport Agency tomorrow in Bozeman to help Montanans apply for or renew a passport and get answers to passport related questions.

Appointments are required, so reserve your spot here at the link below:

https://t.co/D1xEb85Ngk

Congratulations to Travis Naugle and Silver Bow Mining for making Montana a Treasure State Again. The acquisition of the troubled Montana Tunnels fully restored full state bonding and will honor more than four million dollars of tax debt to Jefferson County Schools. Good news for America’s critical mineral supply chain and great news for high paying Montana jobs. Bravo Zulu!

@RMEF has been one of the strongest conservation partners in Montana and across the West, and I’m honored to receive their Excellence in Advocacy Award. From keeping public lands in public hands to improving elk migration corridors and restoring healthy forests, we share a belief that conservation works best when hunters, landowners, states, tribes, and federal managers are at the table.
Go Cats Go! 🇺🇸🇺🇸 https://t.co/fxUZfUfN2T

Honored to receive Safari Club International’s Legislator of the Year Award. @SafariClubIntl has been a strong partner in protecting access to public lands and advancing responsible wildlife management. I look forward to continuing our work together to conserve America’s outdoor heritage for generations to come.
President Trump prefers peace but is prepared for war. Read more in my piece in the @dcexaminer https://t.co/T5BX4quJWO
Two things Democrats continue to vote against: the integrity of our elections and the strength of our military. That tells you all you need to know. https://t.co/rP5k647bUo

Thanks to everyone who stopped by Montana Coffee this morning. The entire Montana delegation gets together every Wednesday Congress is in session. If you’re visiting Washington from Montana, reach out to my office to RSVP. I hope to see you there! https://t.co/pfq6iyqYPg

Whitefish broke ground yesterday on a 9/11 memorial featuring three steel beams recovered from the World Trade Center. The memorial will be dedicated on September 11, marking 25 years since the attacks. Montana will never forget.

https://t.co/K1ThrF5R8S

In a recent survey conducted by my office, 87% of respondents said Congress should reduce the tax burden on working families. The OBBB delivered an average tax cut of $3,575 for the Montana taxpayer, but more relief is needed. Congress should keep fighting to let hardworking Montanans keep more of what they earn.

Montana innovation is helping protect America. I was proud to see Bozeman's S2 Corporation's technology supporting the security of our Nation's Capital during the America 250 celebration by scanning the airwaves for potential threats like drones, helping security teams detect and respond quickly. Montana's defense industry is delivering cutting-edge technology that keeps our country safe while creating good-paying jobs here at home.
Wow. What a loss of a great American Patriot and true friend. Senator Graham will be missed by many. Fair winds and following seas, Colonel. https://t.co/jiMLi4E5XJ

Thank you, Will. I appreciate your kind words and your support. Public lands belong in public hands, and every American should have the opportunity to enjoy them without unnecessary barriers. I'll always fight to protect access and support the communities that depend on our parks. Glacier is my home and it is my mission to protect it for Montana.

Happy Independence Day Montana!

250 years ago, our Founding Fathers risked everything to give birth to the greatest nation the world has ever known. Today, 250 years later, America stands stronger than ever as history’s greatest champion of freedom.

May God bless the United States of America and all those who defend her.

Great opportunity for Montana students! The 2026 Patriot Games bring together students from across the country to compete, have some fun, showcase their skills on a national stage, and compete for a $250,000 scholarship.

Applications are open now at https://t.co/VHXN7tBjKw and are due July 10, 2026.

Had a lot of fun today putting the finishing touches on part of America’s 250th Birthday Cake. What a perfect way to represent Montana with one of our most iconic trout! Thank you to @America250 for letting me be a part of this work of patriotic culinary art. https://t.co/LSwcQFeDMm

Safety alert! Visitors and locals, please follow all park closures, avoid flooded areas, and stay informed by checking the park website and social media feeds as conditions change. Stay safe, and don't put yourself in a dangerous spot, forcing first responders to get into a dangerous spot. 

https://t.co/p3F0VidK8R

Honored to receive the U.S. Park Police Officers' Choice Award from the U.S. Park Police Fraternal Order of Police. I will always support the brave men and women who protect our public lands and those who visit them every day. Thank you for this recognition. https://t.co/d7wee7BiMn

Yesterday, my staff took a flyover to view the proposed Blackfoot Clearwater Stewardship Project. Here are a few photos from the flight. It’s a beautiful view of some of the most picturesque land in America. https://t.co/zjXSXfak5v

The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse, and House Republicans are doing the job we were sent here to do. These bills advance Montana priorities by investing in rural infrastructure, strengthening our public lands, supporting forest management and wildfire mitigation, honoring commitments to tribal communities, supporting our veterans, securing the border, and ensuring taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly. Chairman Cole's leadership has put Congress back on track as we work to move these bills across the finish line. Promises made. Promises kept.

Montanans visiting Washington, D.C. for the Fourth of July should take time to visit the Great American State Fair on the National Mall, running from today through July 10. From rodeos and state expos to Military & Veterans Appreciation Day, it's a fitting way to celebrate 250 years of American history in our nation's capital.

Get tickets here: https://t.co/NmEG1B26Xo

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Commit — Secure America Act (S 2)
roll_calls.plain_language: S. 2, the Secure America Act, provides $70 billion to the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities, under budget reconciliation procedures. A motion to commit, like a motion to recommit, is the minority's last formal chance to send the bill to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it to committee; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Secure America Act (S 2)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill provides $70 billion in funding to the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
